HTML entities and character
encoding
HTML source Browser text · <h1> <h1> · Tom & Jerry Tom & Jerry · UTF-8: character encoding; entities: markup escapes
Read the diagram step by step

Entities represent reserved characters in markup. The browser decodes < and > to
literal angle brackets. UTF-8 specifies how character data is encoded; it is distinct from
HTML escaping.
HTML entity එකෙකින් reserved characters text Jලස Jපෙන්වනවා. UTF-8 කියෙන්Jන් characters encode කෙරන කෙක්‍රිමයෙ. HTML escaping සහ character encoding Jදෙකෙ Jවනස්.
